brand_territory.name: Mission-grade scientific benchmark system
brand_territory.positioning: NASA/mission-systems seriousness, high-profile scientific editorial restraint, and premium strategy-deck clarity without copying NASA marks or using decorative space wallpaper.
personality: premium through restraint, spacing, and evidence

isgp_live_rhythm.borrow: mission-measurement rhythm, dark/light proof-object alternation, audience-question bridges
isgp_live_rhythm.do_not_copy: decorative space atmosphere or dense technical timing overload

kmu_proof_stage.use_for: method bridges and first-time viewer explanation
kmu_proof_stage.borrow: one proof stage per slide, real source authority plus custom interpretation
kmu_proof_stage.do_not_copy: long lecture pacing or institutional ledgers

awg_share_safety_zstack.use_for: release boundaries, source/caveat packaging, controlled sharing
awg_share_safety_zstack.borrow: clean-room visible text, quiet source strips, proof-object hierarchy
awg_share_safety_zstack.do_not_copy: sponsor-board density in introductory method slides

k562_compact_proof_object.use_for: compact scientific proof-object slides and single-cell/state-space views
k562_compact_proof_object.borrow: large scientific object, sparse callouts, explicit caveats
k562_compact_proof_object.do_not_copy: UMAP aesthetics when the evidence is not state-space evidence

pbs_benchmark_concept.borrow: open canvas, fields, rails, metric ledgers, direct labels
pbs_benchmark_concept.do_not_copy: PBS-specific application language or Anthropic framing

trivedi_ecosystem_context.use_for: late collaboration, ecosystem, or future-work context
trivedi_ecosystem_context.borrow: people/network placement only when it supports translation context

manuscript_editorial.borrow: flat evidence-first figure discipline and caption-compatible labels
manuscript_editorial.do_not_copy: slide-only atmosphere, large shadows, or keynote headlines

color_rules.test_red: Use only for held-out/test/trust boundary semantics.
color_rules.model_purple: Use as a secondary model/fit operation color, never as the dominant deck hue.
color_rules.paper: Use for evidence surfaces, not decorative cards.
color_rules.grayscale_rule: Color must be supported by position, shape, line style, or labels.

z_layers.name: canvas_atmosphere
z_layers.implementation: subtle warm/cool field, faint grain, no wallpaper

z_layers.name: measurement_infrastructure
z_layers.implementation: thin rules, low alpha, never dominant

z_layers.name: evidence_surface
z_layers.implementation: large band, plate, or crop with minimal border

z_layers.name: proof_objects
z_layers.meaning: task record, mission nodes, result crop, document strip
z_layers.implementation: slightly elevated objects with semantic color

z_layers.name: trust_boundary
z_layers.meaning: held-out mission, train-only guard, claim boundary
z_layers.implementation: restrained red line, gate, or focus window

z_layers.name: motion_focus
z_layers.meaning: one directional path or focus transition
z_layers.implementation: single trajectory, crop window, or transfer line

proof_object.semantic_use: source-derived proof, task record, mission document

dominant_evidence.semantic_use: one central evidence object per slide

thesis.primary_object: fragmented source field compressing into evaluation surface

anti_patterns: large bordered panels that read as card boxes
raw local paths in visible text
red used as a generic highlight
